description: This file provides functions for applying patches to files, including reading files asynchronously, computing replacements based on chunks, and seeking sequences within lines. It is part of a patch update mechanism in a codebase.

methods.name: defaultReadFile
methods.description: Reads a file asynchronously using Node.js promises.

methods.name: applyUpdateHunk
methods.description: Applies a series of chunks (patches) to a file's contents and returns the updated content as a string.

methods.name: computeReplacements
methods.description: Calculates the line replacements needed to apply the chunks to the original lines.

methods.name: applyReplacements
methods.description: Performs the actual line replacements on the file content based on computed replacements.

methods.name: seekSequence
methods.description: Searches for a sequence of lines within the file starting from a given index, with various normalization options.

methods.name: linesMatch
methods.description: Checks if a pattern matches a sequence of lines starting at a specific index, with normalization.

methods.name: normalizePunctuation
methods.description: Normalizes various Unicode punctuation characters to standard ASCII equivalents.
